arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math
import statistics

# National Defense expenditures (millions of dollars) for fiscal years 1933-1941
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # includes emergency ship construction per the note
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates: ln(E_t / E_{t-1})
years = list(range(1934, 1942))
log_growth_rates = []

for year in years:
    prev_year = year - 1
    growth_rate = math.log(expenditures[year] / expenditures[prev_year])
    log_growth_rates.append(growth_rate)
    print(f"Year {year}: ln({expenditures[year]}/{expenditures[prev_year]}) = ln({expenditures[year]/expenditures[prev_year]:.4f}) = {growth_rate:.6f}")

print(f"\nLog growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")

# Calculate mean and population standard deviation
n = len(log_growth_rates)
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / n

# Population standard deviation
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)

# Coefficient of variation = pop_std / mean
cv = pop_std / mean

print(f"\nMean of log growth rates: {mean:.6f}")
print(f"Population standard deviation: {pop_std:.6f}")
print(f"Coefficient of variation (CV): {cv:.6f}")
print(f"\nRounded to nearest hundredth: {cv:.2f}")
EOF
